decisions_user_stated.2026-10-22: Height nodata is NaN everywhere; no water class; absent height normalizes to the mean; aux pass makes height a gap above 25 % in-county NaN.
decisions_user_stated.2026-10-24: Go for the real aux pass, then the census, after the read-only dry run and probes.
decisions_user_stated.2026-10-24_after_census: Keep the 38 frame_2016-gap tiles; no sen2cor fallback ('we will not have all data for all tiles always'). Step 4 reports per-year counts under every bar (full, without frame_2016/S1-2016, eligible only) with has_frame_2016 to be carried per plot-year (built before the freeze); the bar is chosen at the quota step. The CLAUDE.md frame_2016 rule stays for training tiles; a dated exception for evaluation tiles (landed in #107). Step 4 moves from Codex (0103) to Claude.

bar_attribution.note: A plot-year on two tiles counts under each tile's cause, so per-cause counts can overlap; per-year eligible and on-bar totals are exact and equal the census's.
